gaps.text: The blog defines no formal roles and names no agents; the 14 agents come from the separate awslabs implementation.

citation.section: §1 AWS: AI-Driven Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC) — Roles

gaps.text: No Scrum Master: 'sprints' become 'bolts', and in aidlc-workflows the Delivery Agent sequences them.

The CI quality gates listed for the Pipeline & Deploy Agent are lint, coverage, security scan, integration tests, manual approval and smoke tests; none checks architecture rules, which an LLM agent (Architecture Reviewer) reviews.
Cross-repo verification appears only as advice in the agent's knowledge file: 'Use contract testing (Pact) to verify compatibility across repos'.
